description_zh: 查询防勒索恢复任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-restore-plans --instance-name sql-test-001 --page-size 20 --current-page 1 --status running --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRestorePlans

parameters.help_zh: 指定要查询的服务器名称
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page.

We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The status of the restoration task. Valid values:

init: initializing
created: creating
running: running
completed: complete
error: failed
restoring: restoring
parameters.help_zh:
备份计划状态。取值包括：
init：初始化中
created：创建中
running：执行中
completed：执行成功
error：执行失败
restoring：恢复中
parameters.name: status

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页面显示的备份恢复任务的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned page
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的备份恢复任务的数量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的备份恢复任务的总数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

RestorePlans.description_en: An array that consists of the restoration tasks

items.description_en: The information about the restoration task

CreatedTime.description_en: The timestamp when the restoration task was created. Unit: milliseconds
CreatedTime.description_zh: 创建恢复任务的时间戳，单位为毫秒

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the server on which the database resides
InstanceName.description_zh: 恢复服务器实例的名称

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the anti-ransomware policy
PolicyId.description_zh: 数据库防勒索备份策略的ID

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the anti-ransomware policy
PolicyName.description_zh: 数据库防勒索备份策略的名称

RestorePoint.description_en: The point in time to which data is restored

Status.description_en:
The status of the restoration task. Valid values:

init: initializing
created: creating
running: running
completed: complete
error: failed
restoring: restoring
Status.description_zh:
备份计划状态。取值包括：
init：初始化中
created：创建中
running：执行中
completed：执行成功
error：执行失败
restoring：恢复中

TargetDatabaseName.description_en: The name of the destination database

TargetInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the destination server

TargetInstanceName.description_en: The name of the destination server

UpdatedTime.description_en: The timestamp when the restoration task was last updated. Unit: milliseconds
UpdatedTime.description_zh: 备份任务最后更新的时间戳，单位为毫秒
